assertions: Judo initiates contact and owns a maintained hold; it does not wait for an incoming action to redirect.
Aikido reacts to a legally observed commitment; it does not create a proactive capture.
Karate accumulates disruption through connected strikes; it is not one heavy armor-breaking commitment.
Axe pays one large commitment for break pressure; it does not accumulate an unarmed combination.
Dagger creates or exploits a close positional opening; it does not require a sheathed preparation state.
Draw sword converts a prepared stance into one release; ordinary sword play sustains offense and defense without resheathing.
Staff controls routes and spacing; it does not inherit spear thrust damage or interception reach.
Spear converts reach into thrust and interception; it does not claim the staff's route-control role.
